archivedClaudeQueueEntries.notes: New Oct. 6 research. National 501(c)(3) opportunity; Community Education is an eligible area. Grants range from a few hundred dollars to a general maximum of $10,000; 2025 average award was $2,450. Foundation emphasizes grassroots organizations and notes most grantees have annual operating budgets of $750,000 or less. Applications are accepted via a brief PDF proposal uploaded through the official site; board meets three times annually as needed. Do not invent prior cohorts or outcomes; use launch projections where needed.
